title: Leviathan Inc. and Corporate Environmental Engagement
authors: Po-Hsuan Hsu; Hao Liang; Pedro Matos
eligible_reason: No firm (unit) fixed effects in any regression: every reghdfe in Codes_HsuLiangMatos_MS.do absorbs trbc_id_yr (industry x year) and country_id only. Main tests (Tables 3-4, 7-10) regress ASSET4 environmental scores on lagged state ownership GUO_state3 (or continuous government_held) with time-varying firm controls. Table 5 is a single-date Fukushima DiD (post_2011 = year > 2011 for all firms, lines 276-277) interacted with state ownership and utility/nuclear indicators. Table 6 uses first-differenced scores (ENVSCORE_d1) on lagged political-orientation changes and on new_stateown (government stake jump > 25 pp, carried forward 3 years), with controls and no firm FE. Not an eligible design.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe; firm-year panel of global firms (ASSET4, Datastream/Worldscope, Orbis), ~2004-2017. FE: TRBC industry x year, country; cluster firm_id. Controls `controls4' (size, leverage, MTB, ROA, IO, HHI, GDP per capita, etc.).
data_files_note: Only public variables (state ownership, country indicators) shipped; data_proprietary_MS.dta with ASSET4 scores and Worldscope controls is for internal replication only and is not in the archive.
screener_notes: Title/authors from readme.txt (not in candidates.csv). No unit FE; outcome data proprietary and not shipped.
